notFound.calcium-deficiency: Searched "calcium deficiency leaf/plant", "calcium deficiency young leaves", "tipburn calcium", "calcium deficiency leaves deformed", "Calciummangel". Only tomato blossom end rot (fruit, not a leaf symptom) and a potato image attributed to aluminium toxicity turned up. No labelled photo of deformed new leaves.
notFound.co2-deficiency: Searched "CO2 deficiency aquarium plant", "carbon dioxide deficiency plant", "aquarium plants etiolated", "CO2 Mangel Aquarium". Nothing on Commons; CO2 shortage is not a labelled land plant symptom, so there is no honest substitute.
notFound.pagoda-stone: Searched "pagoda stone", "pagoda stone aquascape/aquarium", "pagoda rock aquarium", "Chinese pagoda stone", "宝塔石", "Baota stone", "aquascape stone layered", "aquascape hardscape stone". Results were temple pagodas, the Blue Mountains Pagoda Rock landform, and Sinoceras nautiloid fossil limestone (the Chinese collectors' "pagoda stone", which is not the layered aquascaping stone). No identified aquascaping pagoda stone.
notFound.texas-holey-rock: Searched "Texas holey rock", "holey limestone", "holey rock", "holey rock aquarium/cichlid", "Texas limestone aquarium", "tufa rock aquarium", "African cichlid tank rocks", "Edwards Plateau limestone holes". Only unrelated "holey rock" landmarks in the UK/US and a Hawaiian cave formation. Nothing identified as Texas holey rock.
